main_commit_message: docs(status): record verified IRQ-safe A06 guest regression without claiming main release
scope: Posthoc summary read from fixed remote sources; no new guest test was executed and no Git reference or repository document was changed.

a06.irq_fix: CpuControl.max uses SpinLock<CpuMax, LocalIrqDisabled> to prevent local timer IRQ lock reentry.
a06.status_source_tree_equivalence_claim: STATUS.md says the kernel was built from the same Git tree as the latest merged A06 source; this summary did not independently compare those two trees.
a06.guest_success_attribution: 6/6 comes from the fixed linked matrix and STATUS.md, not from a new test in this read-only check; STATUS.md reports raw33 and no panic.
a06.test_environment: QEMU q35/TCG, x86_64, 1 vCPU, 512 MiB; original A01 initramfs plus statically linked guest CPU probe; no host cgroup, data disk or network changes
a06.historical_timeout_status: The previous 1% cpu.stat timeout remains historical evidence and is not the latest A06 branch result.
remaining_limitations: 1% observed around 1.9-2.0%; tick overshoot and exact quota remain unresolved
cgroup migration/lifecycle and strict lock order not accepted
HOS2 CapSpace/ioctl, Hepta persistent effects and physical hardware not accepted
main has no release qualification for the new kernel CPU limits
